message.content: {"caption":"A stacked-bar chart tracks the increasing size and changing composition of a skill library over training steps.","description":"The chart, titled “Skill Library Evolution,” has Training Steps on the x-axis (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, 150) and Number of Skills on the y-axis, marked from 0 to 120 in increments of 20. Each bar is stacked in the legend order: General (rose), Pick (light pink), Look (blue), Clean (light cyan), Heat (mint), Cool (pale yellow), Pick2 (orange), and Mistakes (gray). A black line with star markers, labeled Total Skills, connects the tops of the bars. Its printed totals rise at every step: 55, 60, 66, 71, 77, 83, 88, 94, and 100. The stacks also grow overall. The estimated component values in chart_values are cumulative y-axis readings at each segment’s top edge, not the individual segment sizes; the final edge is the full bar
